selection: Complete fixed 24-pair coverage for both candidates. Select highest paired points if above 50%, all isolation checks pass and zero operational failures. Ties prefer aspiration-only. This is exploratory selection, not an improvement confidence claim. If neither clears, inspect failures and develop a new focused candidate using fresh positions.
overnight: One frozen winner against exact released Odin v5 on 56 separate candidate-blind opening pairs, 112 games at 120s+500ms; no result-based early stopping. Review paired uncertainty and all faults before promotion.
cpu_layout: Laptop four lanes on CPUs4-7 cover screen indices0-15 for each candidate. VPS two lanes on CPUs0-1 cover indices16-23 for each. Only one active mover per lane/core. Report platform strata separately.
